stay.name: Relais Dattilo

packages.name: Regalati un’esperienza unica
packages.includes: A night in a double room with breakfast, a bottle of Ceraudo wine in the room, dinner for two at Ristorante Dattilo (nine courses, with an aperitif glass), a cellar visit
packages.when: Every day the restaurant is open except public holidays and August; by email booking only

packages.name: Scopri il mondo Ceraudo
packages.includes: A night in a double room with breakfast, a bottle of Ceraudo wine in the room, dinner for two at Ristorante Dattilo (five courses, with an aperitif glass), a visit to the estate
packages.when: Every day the restaurant is open except public holidays and August; by email booking only

stay.note: Relais Dattilo is a wine-estate relais with eight rooms beside the restaurant; the Ceraudo shop lists a third, dearer €790 package.
